math_checks.outcome: Checked the mathematical suggestion in the p13 question for the ordinary category of groupoids and functors. Let G=S_3 and H={e,(12)}. The inclusion BH -> BG between one-object groupoids is monic. If a classifier t:1 -> Omega existed, its pullback along a characteristic functor BG -> Omega would have, at its unique object, the kernel of the induced group homomorphism G -> Aut_Omega(t(*)). Such a subgroup is normal. But H is not normal: conjugating (12) by (123) gives (23), outside H. Thus this monomorphism cannot be classified, so there is no subobject classifier in that ordinary category. This checks the suggested obstruction under the stated interpretation; it does not identify the writer's unstated categorical conventions or check other topos axioms. The original question and its wording remain unchanged.
